import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyCircleProductConnecting
import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyCircleProductRetraction
import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyRing

/-!
# Cup products in circle-overlap coordinates

The two components of the antipodal overlap are identified with the first
factor by pullbacks. These coordinates preserve cups, and a first-factor
class has the same value on both components.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance 2000] Prod.instModule

open CategoryTheory Limits HomologicalComplex

namespace Mumford.Analytic

private theorem biprodIsoProd_hom_apply (M N : ModuleCat ℤ)
    (a : (M ⊞ N : ModuleCat ℤ)) :
    (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd M N).hom a =
      ((biprod.fst : M ⊞ N ⟶ M) a, (biprod.snd : M ⊞ N ⟶ N) a) := by
  have hf : (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd M N).hom ≫
      ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.fst ℤ M N) = biprod.fst := by
    apply (cancel_epi (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd M N).inv).mp
    simp
  have hs : (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd M N).hom ≫
      ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.snd ℤ M N) = biprod.snd := by
    apply (cancel_epi (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd M N).inv).mp
    simp
  exact Prod.ext (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hf a) (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hs a)

private theorem discreteProductCohomologyIso_coordinates
    (X D : TopCat) [DiscreteTopology D] (d₀ d₁ : D) (hne : d₀ ≠ d₁)
    (hD : ∀ d : D, d = d₀ ∨ d = d₁) (n : ℕ)
    (a : IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (X × D)) n) :
    (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd _ _).hom
      ((discreteProductCohomologyIso X D d₀ d₁ hne hD n).hom a) =
      (singularCohomologyPullback (discreteProductSection X D d₀) n a,
        singularCohomologyPullback (discreteProductSection X D d₁) n a) := by
  rw [biprodIsoProd_hom_apply]
  apply Prod.ext
  · have h := discreteProductCohomologyIso_hom_fst X D d₀ d₁ hne hD n
    rw [← singularCohomologyPullback_eq_homologyMap] at h
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom h a
  · have h := discreteProductCohomologyIso_hom_snd X D d₀ d₁ hne hD n
    rw [← singularCohomologyPullback_eq_homologyMap] at h
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom h a

private theorem realUnitSphereProductCohomologyIso_cup
    (X : TopCat) {p q n : ℕ} (h : p + q = n)
    (a : IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (X × Metric.sphere (0 : ℝ) 1)) p)
    (b : IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (X × Metric.sphere (0 : ℝ) 1)) q) :
    (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd _ _).hom
      ((realUnitSphereProductCohomologyIso X n).hom
        (singularCohomologyCup _ p q n h a b)) =
      (singularCohomologyCup X p q n h
        ((ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd _ _).hom
          ((realUnitSphereProductCohomologyIso X p).hom a)).1
        ((ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd _ _).hom
          ((realUnitSphereProductCohomologyIso X q).hom b)).1,
      singularCohomologyCup X p q n h
        ((ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd _ _).hom
          ((realUnitSphereProductCohomologyIso X p).hom a)).2
        ((ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd _ _).hom
          ((realUnitSphereProductCohomologyIso X q).hom b)).2) := by
  unfold realUnitSphereProductCohomologyIso
  rw [discreteProductCohomologyIso_coordinates,
    discreteProductCohomologyIso_coordinates, discreteProductCohomologyIso_coordinates]
  simp only [singularCohomologyPullback_cup]

/-- Antipodal-overlap coordinates preserve cup products componentwise. -/
theorem circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv_cup
    (X : TopCat) (v : Circle) {p q n : ℕ} (h : p + q = n)
    (a : IntegralSingularCohomology
      (TopCat.of (circleProductChart X v ∩ circleProductChart X (-v) :
        Set (X × Circle))) p)
    (b : IntegralSingularCohomology
      (TopCat.of (circleProductChart X v ∩ circleProductChart X (-v) :
        Set (X × Circle))) q) :
    circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv X v n
      (singularCohomologyCup _ p q n h a b) =
      (singularCohomologyCup X p q n h
        (circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv X v p a).1
        (circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv X v q b).1,
      singularCohomologyCup X p q n h
        (circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv X v p a).2
        (circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv X v q b).2) := by
  change (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd _ _).hom
    ((realUnitSphereProductCohomologyIso X n).hom
      (singularCohomologyPullback
        (TopCat.ofHom (circleProductIntersectionHomotopyEquiv X v).invFun) n
        (singularCohomologyCup _ p q n h a b))) = _
  rw [singularCohomologyPullback_cup]
  exact realUnitSphereProductCohomologyIso_cup X h _ _

/-- A class pulled back from the first factor restricts diagonally to the
two overlap components. -/
theorem circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv_pullback
    (X : TopCat) (v : Circle) (n : ℕ) (a : IntegralSingularCohomology X n) :
    circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv X v n
      (singularCohomologyPullback
        (singularSubsetInclusion (TopCat.of (X × Circle))
          (circleProductChart X v ∩ circleProductChart X (-v))) n
        (circleProductCohomologyPullback X n a)) = (a, a) := by
  have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (circleProductIntersection_projection_diagonal X v n) a
  rw [← singularCohomologyPullback_eq_homologyMap] at h
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at h
  have hp : singularCohomologyPullback
      (singularSubsetInclusion (TopCat.of (X × Circle))
        (circleProductChart X v ∩ circleProductChart X (-v))) n
      (circleProductCohomologyPullback X n a) =
      singularCohomologyPullback
        (TopCat.ofHom ⟨fun p : (circleProductChart X v ∩ circleProductChart X (-v) :
          Set (X × Circle)) => p.1.1,
          continuous_fst.comp continuous_subtype_val⟩) n a := by
    change ((singularCohomologyPullback _ n).comp
      (singularCohomologyPullback _ n)) a = _
    rw [← singularCohomologyPullback_comp]
    rfl
  rw [hp]
  change (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd _ _).hom
    ((circleProductIntersectionCohomologyIso X v n).hom _) = _
  refine (congrArg ((ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd _ _).hom) h).trans ?_
  rw [biprodIsoProd_hom_apply]
  exact Prod.ext
    (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (biprod.lift_fst (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)) a)
    (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (biprod.lift_snd (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)) a)

/-- Cupping a restricted first-factor class with the degree-zero class of
the first overlap component gives exactly its first-component representative. -/
theorem circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv_cup_first_component
    (X : TopCat) (v : Circle) (n : ℕ) (a : IntegralSingularCohomology X n) :
    singularCohomologyCup _ n 0 n rfl
      (singularCohomologyPullback
        (singularSubsetInclusion (TopCat.of (X × Circle))
          (circleProductChart X v ∩ circleProductChart X (-v))) n
        (circleProductCohomologyPullback X n a))
      ((circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv X v 0).symm
        (singularCohomologyOne X, 0)) =
      (circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv X v n).symm (a, 0) := by
  apply (circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv X v n).injective
  rw [circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv_cup,
    circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv_pullback,
    LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  simp [singularCohomologyCup_one_right]

/-- Multiplication on the left by the degree-zero first-component class
also picks out the first overlap coordinate. -/
theorem circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv_first_component_cup
    (X : TopCat) (v : Circle) (n : ℕ) (a : IntegralSingularCohomology X n) :
    singularCohomologyCup _ 0 n n (Nat.zero_add n)
      ((circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv X v 0).symm
        (singularCohomologyOne X, 0))
      (singularCohomologyPullback
        (singularSubsetInclusion (TopCat.of (X × Circle))
          (circleProductChart X v ∩ circleProductChart X (-v))) n
        (circleProductCohomologyPullback X n a)) =
      (circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv X v n).symm (a, 0) := by
  apply (circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv X v n).injective
  rw [circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv_cup,
    circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv_pullback,
    LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  simp [singularCohomologyCup_one_left]

/-- A map of the first factors, with the circle coordinate fixed. -/
def circleProductMap {X Y : TopCat} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    TopCat.of (X × Circle) ⟶ TopCat.of (Y × Circle) :=
  TopCat.ofHom ⟨fun p => (f p.1, p.2),
    (f.hom.continuous.comp continuous_fst).prodMk continuous_snd⟩

/-- The map of ordered antipodal overlaps induced by a map of first factors. -/
def circleProductOverlapMap {X Y : TopCat} (f : X ⟶ Y) (v : Circle) :
    TopCat.of (circleProductChart X v ∩ circleProductChart X (-v) : Set (X × Circle)) ⟶
      TopCat.of (circleProductChart Y v ∩ circleProductChart Y (-v) : Set (Y × Circle)) :=
  TopCat.ofHom ⟨fun p => ⟨(f p.1.1, p.1.2), p.2⟩,
    ((circleProductMap f).hom.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _⟩

/-- The two overlap coordinates are natural in the first factor. -/
theorem circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv_naturality {X Y : TopCat}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (v : Circle) (n : ℕ)
    (a : IntegralSingularCohomology
      (TopCat.of (circleProductChart Y v ∩ circleProductChart Y (-v) : Set (Y × Circle))) n) :
    circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv X v n
      (singularCohomologyPullback (circleProductOverlapMap f v) n a) =
      (singularCohomologyPullback f n (circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv Y v n a).1,
        singularCohomologyPullback f n (circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv Y v n a).2) := by
  change (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd _ _).hom
    ((realUnitSphereProductCohomologyIso X n).hom
      (singularCohomologyPullback
        (TopCat.ofHom (circleProductIntersectionHomotopyEquiv X v).invFun) n
        (singularCohomologyPullback (circleProductOverlapMap f v) n a))) =
    (singularCohomologyPullback f n
      ((ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd _ _).hom
        ((realUnitSphereProductCohomologyIso Y n).hom
          (singularCohomologyPullback
            (TopCat.ofHom (circleProductIntersectionHomotopyEquiv Y v).invFun) n a))).1,
      singularCohomologyPullback f n
        ((ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd _ _).hom
          ((realUnitSphereProductCohomologyIso Y n).hom
            (singularCohomologyPullback
              (TopCat.ofHom (circleProductIntersectionHomotopyEquiv Y v).invFun) n a))).2)
  unfold realUnitSphereProductCohomologyIso
  rw [discreteProductCohomologyIso_coordinates, discreteProductCohomologyIso_coordinates]
  apply Prod.ext <;>
    simp only [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← singularCohomologyPullback_comp] <;> rfl

end Mumford.Analytic
